governing_acts: Directive 76/211/EEC (Approximation of the laws of Member States relating to the making-up by weight or volume of certain prepackaged products)
Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 (Food Information to Consumers - FIC)
Directive 98/6/EC (Indication of prices of products offered to consumers)

requirements.title: Estimated Sign (℮-Mark) Compliance
requirements.target_rule: Directive 76/211/EEC allows prepackages meeting the Three Packers' Rules (average weight >= nominal, limited tolerable negative error TNE) to bear the small '℮' mark.
requirements.indian_rule: Indian LMPC enforces individual maximum permissible error (MPE) under Schedule II; the '℮' mark is not used under Indian domestic rules.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Apply for EU statistical batch average verification to affix the CE/℮-mark symbol (min 3mm height) next to nominal quantity.

requirements.title: Prohibition of Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
requirements.target_rule: Resale price maintenance and government-mandated price printing are strictly prohibited under Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU) Article 101. Directive 98/6/EC mandates unit pricing (price per kg or litre) at retail.
requirements.indian_rule: Mandatory printing of Maximum Retail Price (MRP inclusive of all taxes) under LMPC Rule 6(1)(e).
requirements.action_required_for_export: Remove all 'MRP' declarations. Retailers in EU must display shelf price and unit price (€/kg or €/L).

requirements.title: Nominal Net Quantity Units
requirements.target_rule: Directive 80/181/EEC mandates metric units: kg or g for weight; l, cl or ml for volume.
requirements.indian_rule: Indian LMPC Rule 13 mandates metric units (g, kg, ml, l).
requirements.action_required_for_export: Ensure font height meets EU minimums (2mm for <=50g, 3mm for 50g-200g, 4mm for 200g-1kg, 6mm for >1kg).

requirements.title: EU-Established Food Business Operator (FBO)
requirements.target_rule: Article 8(1) of Regulation (EU) 1169/2011 mandates the name or business name and address of the food business operator established within the European Union.
requirements.indian_rule: Rule 6(1)(a) requires manufacturer/packer in India or Indian importer.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Add name and postal address of the authorized EU importer or EU-established business entity.

requirements.title: Mandatory Nutritional Declaration per 100g/100ml
requirements.target_rule: Article 30 of Regulation (EU) 1169/2011 requires tabular nutritional declaration: Energy (kJ and kcal), fat, of which saturates, carbohydrate, of which sugars, protein, and salt (expressed as 'salt', NOT sodium).
requirements.indian_rule: Under Indian FSSAI, sodium is declared instead of salt, and energy is often in kcal only.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Convert sodium to salt (Salt = Sodium x 2.5) and include energy in both kJ and kcal per 100g/100ml.

requirements.title: 14 Mandatory EU Allergens Highlighted in Ingredients
requirements.target_rule: Annex II of Regulation 1169/2011 mandates 14 substances (Cereals containing gluten, Crustaceans, Eggs, Fish, Peanuts, Soybeans, Milk, Nuts, Celery, Mustard, Sesame, Sulphites >10mg/kg, Lupin, Molluscs) highlighted with distinct typography (e.g. bold font) in ingredients list.
requirements.indian_rule: Allergen statement permitted as separate 'Contains...' clause.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Emphasize specific allergen ingredients in bold lettering directly within the ingredient listing.

requirements.title: Destination Member State Official Language
requirements.target_rule: Article 15 of Regulation 1169/2011 requires mandatory particulars in a language easily understood by the consumers of the Member States where food is marketed (e.g. French in France, German in Germany).
requirements.action_required_for_export: Provide multi-lingual label or localized sticker in official language of destination EU country.
